disease.title: Plant Disease Diagnosis & Crop Protection
disease.subtitle: Upload or capture a leaf photo for AI diagnosis, quality checking, and organic IPM recommendations.
disease.supported_crops_desc: The pretrained computer vision model classifies foliar lesions across 14 crops. For crops outside this benchmark, visual similarity matches are returned with a clear mismatch notice.
disease.drag_drop_text: Drag and drop leaf photo here, or browse from device
disease.select_farm_label: Select Farm (Optional, for microclimate fungal risk)
disease.opt_in_outbreak_label: Contribute anonymized village report to Community Outbreak Map
disease.opt_in_outbreak_hint: Privacy guaranteed: Uploaded leaf photo is never stored. Only village centroid and detected disease are shared.
disease.ipm_disclaimer: Strict safety guideline: Cultural and organic steps only. Zero specific chemical dosages are provided without certified ground agronomist prescription.
disease.uncertain_warning: Diagnosis is inconclusive due to low prediction confidence. Please consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture Officer before applying any treatment.
disease.no_history: No previous disease reports submitted yet.
disease.ready_desc: Upload or capture an affected plant leaf. Our on-device vision agent will evaluate photo sharpness, classify foliar symptoms, and recommend organic IPM controls.
disease.photo_tips_title: Tips for capturing a diagnostic leaf photo:
disease.photo_tip_1: Hold the camera steady 15–20 cm away from the affected foliar lesion.
disease.photo_tip_2: Ensure soft, even daylight without severe harsh shadows or direct flash glare.
disease.photo_tip_3: Frame a single symptomatic leaf against a natural or neutral background.
disease.speech_not_supported: Speech synthesis is not supported in this browser.
disease.no_voice_for_language: No speech synthesis voice found on your device for {lang}. Audio cannot be played.
